stem.text: Solid carbon dioxide, $\text{CO}_2$, is similar to solid iodine, $\text{I}_2$, in its structure.
Which statement about solid $\text{CO}_2$ and solid $\text{SiO}_2$ is correct?

A.text: Both solid $\text{CO}_2$ and solid $\text{SiO}_2$ exist in a lattice structure.

B.text: Both solid $\text{CO}_2$ and solid $\text{SiO}_2$ have a simple molecular structure.

C.text: Both solid $\text{CO}_2$ and solid $\text{SiO}_2$ have atoms joined by single covalent bonds.

D.text: Both solid $\text{CO}_2$ and solid $\text{SiO}_2$ change spontaneously to gas at s.t.p..
